sources: Vantage analysis of Q2 FY27 results filed on BSE and Q1–Q2 FY27 earnings calls; Vantage sector intel, 20 Nov 2026
title: Sterile makers held or lifted margins; novel-drug bets' fell
dek: Gland's margin rose 5.3 pts to 26.4% with vial lines 92% full and OneSource reached 32%, while Wockhardt's fell 4.9 pts in its first quarter after Zaynich's approval and Zydus's 8.9 pts.

chart.title: EBITDA margin change, Q2 FY27 vs Q2 FY26
chart.sub: operating margin from filed results (consolidated) · text = Q2 FY27 margin · change in percentage points

stats.label: Gland's liquid-vial utilisation
stats.note: Heading to ≈102% next year; new isolator vial lines start only in FY2030.

stats.label: OneSource EBITDA margin
stats.note: Up from about 27.5% in Q1 after its second GLP-1 cartridge line went live.

stats.label: Zydus margin cost of Saroglitazar
stats.note: Management: Q2's 24% margin would be ≈150 bps higher without US launch spend.

read: Approved, full sterile lines are earning now; the novel drugs are still costing money. Watch Zaynich's first US sales.
notes: Margins are operating (EBITDA) margins from consolidated Q2 FY27 results filed on BSE. OneSource's results are not in the desk's filed set; its change is derived from the call (32% margin, revenue +37%, EBITDA +53%), so it is approximate. Glenmark is left out because its year-ago quarter included the AbbVie upfront for ISB 2001, Orchid because its results compare post-merger with pre-merger figures, and Aurobindo because only standalone results (excluding the Eugia injectables arm) were filed. Zydus's fall also reflects a strong year-ago quarter and higher R&D and amortisation; management attributes about 1.5 pts to the Saroglitazar launch. Wockhardt held no Q2 call.
